tools.name: compute_column
tools.description:
Add a column computed from arithmetic over an uploaded file's numeric columns, then map it. Pass file_key, expression and result_column, e.g. {"file_key": "...", "expression": "(revenue - cost) / population", "result_column": "profit_per_capita"}.

Operators: + - * / % and parentheses, or a single c

tools.description: Return the server's capability matrix: supported map types, geo types, output formats, classification methods, and the list of tools available in this process (which varies by configuration). Call this first to discover what the server can do.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "territory_mapping" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload_file · Private data: compute_column, geocode, pincode_lookup, question_to_map, reverse_geocode, territory_mapping, upload_file · Public sink: compute_column, pincode_lookup, territory_mapping, upload_file · Destructive: territory_mapping, upload_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload_file · Private data: compute_column, geocode, pincode_lookup, question_to_map, reverse_geocode, territory_mapping, upload_file · Public sink: compute_column, pincode_lookup, territory_mapping, upload_file · Destructive: territory_mapping, upload_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
